description: Embed files in a PDF as attachments, for example an XML or CSV data file. Each entry in files has a source (an https:// URL or a data: URI with base64, never a local path) and optional name, mime_type, description (at most 1,000 characters) and relationship. Existing content, including any existing attachments, is kept. At most 10 files and 3 MB in total per call, and at most 200 attachments in the finished PDF. A PDF whose list of embedded files has over 2,000 entries (name_tree_too_large) or an unreadable existing name (attachments_too_complex) is refused. A name already used by an attachment in the PDF (as a key or as an entry's /UF or /F), or twice in the call, is refused. Unknown keys are rejected. The whole file is saved again, so an existing digital signature on the PDF stops validating. Each file keeps its full name; a plain-ASCII lookup key for each is returned as keys. Returns the PDF inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

files.description: Files to embed. Nothing is added unless every entry is valid.

mime_type.description: For example text/xml: no parameters and no #.

name.description: Attachment name, 1-255 characters and at most 255 UTF-8 bytes, with no / or backslash or control characters. Default: last part of an https:// URL path (a data: URI needs a name).

relationship.description: PDF/A-3 AFRelationship: Alternative, Data, Source, Supplement or Unspecified. Default Unspecified.

source.description: File source: an https:// URL or a data:<type>;base64,… URI.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_add_attachment

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

keys.description: One entry per added file, in order: the ASCII key for qpdf --show-attachment (qpdf --list-attachments shows it)

name.description: The file name, cut to 40 characters

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Embed files in a PDF
